title: The Radio Said I'd Been Missing for Three Days #shorts #scarystories
description:
I only pulled over by the lake for five minutes. The diner's guest book says otherwise.

Follow for new scary stories every day.

#scarystory #horrorstories #creepy #shorts

beats.text: The radio said I'd been missing for three days. I'd pulled over for five minutes.
Hot summer night. I'd stopped by the lake to stretch.
Then the crickets went silent. All at once.
A white light hung over the water. Not a sound.
I blinked. Battery dead. The clock said two fourteen.
So I walked to the only lights on the road.
The waitress poured my coffee before I ordered.
She said, you look better than last time.
I'd never been here. She turned the guest book around.
My name. My handwriting. Forty-one times.
Every line said the same thing. Don't go back to the lake.

overlay.text: DON'T GO BACK TO THE LAKE

beats.text: The white light was waiting over the parking lot.
I woke up in my car, by the water, engine running.
